reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets more than doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to 1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026). The dominant mechanism is a billing import/validation defect: a majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025) are based on accepted ACTUAL meter reads rather than estimate-substitution, showing wrong bills are produced during billing import/validation processing itself (not by read acquisition alone), consistent with a change to validation rules around August. Separately, manual-read route completion fell to 88% against a 95% target, contributing estimate-substitution errors to the remaining ESTIMATED-read disputes. The surge is not explained by response-handling capacity (CS already within SLA) nor by a tariff change (none logged) nor by AMI pipeline failure (ruled out by actual-read dominance).
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets more than doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to 1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-02). The dominant identified mechanism behind the ESTIMATED-read portion of disputed bills (1240 of 3025, E-05) is a billing-import validation defect: rule BV-17, deployed 2026-08-01, compares the raw AMI register value against 12-month m3 history with no unit scaling (E-13); AMI firmware v4.2, rolled out June 2026, reports register readings in 0.1 m3 units rather than whole m3 (E-14), so BV-17 misreads valid v4.2 consumption as anomalous and rejects it (REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION) despite the read having been received before cutoff, triggering estimate substitution for 1184 of 1240 AMI-channel ESTIMATED-dispute accounts (E-12). This is not a response-handling-capacity problem (CS within SLA, E-01), not a tariff change (none logged, E-04), not AMI delivery/pipeline failure (reads were received, not undelivered, E-12), and not manual-read route completion (the ESTIMATED-dispute bucket is itself AMI-channel, not manually routed, per E-12, contradicting the prior route-completion premise).
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
